# MrW Overlay for POE 2 v2.18.0

## What's new

- **Map loot, Alt+I:** see what each map really brought. The app reads the currency in your inventory before a map and after it; what the inventory gained, at the loot filter's prices, is the map's loot. Pick a rule in Settings → Price check → **Inventory scan**: it stays **Off** until you choose.
  - **Automatic:** whenever the inventory is open in your hideout or town, it is read about once a second (never in a map). The last read before you leave is where the map starts; back home, open the inventory before stashing and the first seconds tell what the map brought.
  - **Manual:** press Alt+I with the inventory open before the map and again when you are back, before stashing. Alt+I shows your inventory's worth at any time.
  - Only items traded on Ange's Currency Exchange count (currency, omens, essences, splinters, fragments, catalysts, uncut gems, flux). Uniques, rares, gear and waystones are left out.
- **Tracker, Map loot tab:** every map with its loot and its time, plus session figures from the game's log: session time, time in maps and in the hideout, loot per map and per hour, average and last map time, the best map and what came in most. AFK time and long hideout stays count as breaks. **Start a new session** compares one farm with the next without deleting anything.
- **Map loot box:** a small box over the game, in maps too, shows whether the next map's starting inventory is read and the figures you pick in the Tracker. Drag it anywhere.

## Fixes

- **Price check:** priced items the trade site's exchange data doesn't list, such as Raven's Reflection, open the currency card instead of an empty item search.
- **Tracker:** "This session" finds the game's start even after very long sessions.

MrW Overlay is built by a player, for players. It is not an official Grinding Gear Games product, and they don't back it.

## Updating

On v1.8.0 or later, update from Settings → **Updates**. Your filter settings, profiles, saved searches and pathofexile.com connection are kept. The Microsoft Store version updates through the Store.

## Install

The release file is `poe2filtre-windows-amd64.exe`. It is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you: **More info → Run anyway**. Or get it from the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PM376D3LFBG
